tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu ru/ lar byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba yin pas/ bla ma la gsol ba thob/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam yin pa'i lha sgoms sngags bzlas la 'bungs/ gnas lugs spros bral yin pas/ 'dzin med lhug par zhog /'khor ba sdug bsngal yin pas/ gang la'ang sred pa spong*/ 'gro drug pha ma yin pas/ byams dang snying rje sgoms/ bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir snying gar sngags 'khor chen mo zhig bsgom par bshad cing*/ yig rnying logs pa zhig kyang yod mod kyi/ dmigs pa gsal thebs pa dka' bas da lta lag len du mi mdzad/ gzhan yang dmigs pa 'dra min du ma 'dug ste/ dkyus kyi lag len la 'debs rgyu/ snying gar 'jam dpal/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa gsal thebs na 'di rang sgom/ mi gsal na snying kha'i 'jam dpal zhi ba rdo rjer bsgom/ gang ltar yang rdo rje'i lte bar nyi gdan la hūṃ/ de'i mtha' skor du bzlas pa gang byed kyi sngags 'phreng gi bskor ba ste/ de'i yig 'bru rnams mgo gyen bltas kha nang bstan mdun nas g.yas skor du 'god pas mdog sngon po yin/ de las 'od zer 'phros lus gang*/ ba spu'i khung bu nas song*/ snang ba thams cad khyab/ 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas snying kha'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ zhal dgu khar nas sngags bzlas shing*/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad las sngags kyi sgra 'byung ba tsam bsgom/ de ltar na rang nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal ba tsam la sems gtad nas/ sngags nyer gcig sogs brgya tsam re bzlas/ de nas snying kha'i sngags 'khor la klog pa'i tshul gyi de tsam re bzlas/ de las 'od zer spro bsdus la de tsam re bzlas/ de rjes zhal dgu dang snang srid thams cad las rang sgra byung bar bsam nas bzla/ hrīḥṣ+ti lta bu dper mtshon na/ sngags 'phreng skor gcig la dmigs pa bzhi po de tshar re tsam 'gro bar byed/ des gzhan gnyis la'ang mtshon/

bye bsnyen song nas nyer sgrub byed na/ sngar gyi 'phro la byas kyang rung*/ bar de mtshams bcad song nas/ slar yang nyer sgrub la zhugs kyang chog /de khyad par med pa lags/ zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /thar pa ru dbu mdzad blo bzang pas lo mtshams byas dus rtag brtan nas gnang ba yin lags/ ༈ yang 'jigs mdzad kyi bsreg blugs bsdus pa'i mjug tu byung ba ni 'di ltar/ snga dro'i thun la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam byed/ thun gzhan 'tshol/ de tshe tshar gsum res chog /bzlas pa'i skabs rang gi bzlas pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nam mkha' khengs pas bzla rogs mdzad par mos/ ya mān+ta ka la 'bum phrag bdun/ hrīḥṣ+tī 'bum phrag bcu bzla dgos/ ya ma ra dza la bzla na 'bum phrag gsum/ thun mtshams su rang phyag gnyis pa gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros par bsam/ gtor chog srod thun kho na la byas pas chog /rmi lam bzang bzang 'dra ba la dga' ba yang mi bya/ 'tshub pa byung na bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang*/ sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur shes pa la nan chags bya/ bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 440 -- PAGE 113 -- PAGE 112 -
